desc.en: Imam Mohummad Baqir (a) has said that whoever recites this Surah with a loud voice, it is as if he has lifted his sword to ?ght in the way of Allah (s) and whoever recites it slowly in his mind, it is as if he has been sacri?ced in the way of Allah and has died a martyr.If a person recites this Surah 10 times, 1000 sins of his are forgiven. If recited in waajib namaz, all previous sins are forgiven. It is narrated from the Holy Prophet (s) that reciting this Surah once carries the reward of fasting for the whole month of Ramadhan. Constant recitation of this Surah, increases sustenance.If Surah Qadr is recited 11 times before sleeping, the reciter remains safe the whole night. Recitation in front of an enemy keeps one safe from his evil designs. For the paying back of loans, one should seek forgiveness and should recite Surah Qadr as many times as possible.Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) said that for pious children, one should keep his right hand on his wife and recite this Surah 7 times before going into her. If recited 7 times on the grave of a believer, his sins will be forgiven.
desc.rurdu: Imam Muhammad Baqir (a) ne farmaya hai keh, jo koi Surah Qadr ko buland awaaz se padhe, to woh aise hi hai keh us ne Allah (s) ki raaha mein jang karne ke liye apni talwaar ko uthaaya hai aur jo aahista apne dil mein padhe, to aisa hi hai keh us ne Allah (s) ki raaha mein apni jaan ko qurbaan karte huwe shahid ho gaya.Agar koi shakhs is Surah ko 10 martaba padhe, to uske 1000 gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge. Agar waajib namaz mein is Surah ko padhe to peechle saare gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge.Rasool-e-Khuda (s) se riwaayat hai keh is Surah ki tilaawat karna yaani purey Maahe Ramazan ke roze ke sawaab ke bara-bar hai. Musalsal is Surah ko padhne se rizq mein izaafa hota hai.Agar Surah Qadr ko soney se pehle 100 martaba padhe, to padhne waal saari raat mehfooz rehta hai. Dushman ke saamne agar is Surah ki tilaawat kare to uske makr se mehfooz rahega. qarz ki adaayegi ke liye, maghferat ki dua karni chahiye aur is Surah ko ziyadah se ziyadah padhna chahiye.Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) ne farmaya hai keh, Nek aur swaaleh aulaad agar kisi ko chahiye to apna seedha haath apni biwi par rakh kar is Surah ko 7 martaba padhe. Agar 7 martaba kisi qabr par padhe, to us qabr waale ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge.
desc.urdu: رسول اکرمؐ نے فرمایا: سورۂ قدر کی تلاوت کرنے والے کا ثواب ماہِ مبارک میں روزہ رکھنے والے کے ثواب کے برابر ہے (مجمع البیان،ج۱۰ ص۴۰۳)۔ امام جعفر صادق ؑ سے مروی ہے : جو شخص واجب نماز میں سورۂ قدر پڑھے تو خدا تعا لیٰ کی طرف سے ایک منا دی ندا دے گا کہ اے شخص!تیرے پچھلے گنا ہ بخش دیئے گئے ہیں اب تو پھر سے عمل کا آغاز کر دے۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

trans.en: Surely We revealed it on the grand night.
trans.rurdu: Be-shak Ham ne usey shab'e qadr mein naazil kiya hai.
trans.urdu: بے شک ہم نے اسے شب قدر میں نازل کیا ہے۔

lines.rarabic: WA MAA ADRAAKA MA LAILATUL QADR.

trans.en: And what will make you comprehend what the grand night is?
trans.rurdu: Aur aap kya jaane yeh shab'e qadr kya cheez hai.
trans.urdu: اور آپ کیا جانیں یہ شب قدر کیا چیز ہے۔

arabic.text: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

lines.rarabic: LAILATUL QADRI KHAIRUM MIN ALFEE SHAHR.

trans.en: The grand night is better than a thousand months.
trans.rurdu: Shab'e qadr hazaar mahino se behtar hai.
trans.urdu: شب قدر ہزار مہینوں سے بہتر ہے۔

arabic.text: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلٰۗئِكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍ

lines.rarabic: TANAZ ZALUL MALAA-IKATU WAR ROOHU FEEHA BI IZNI-RAB BIHIM MIN KULLI AMR.

trans.en: The angels and the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord for every affair
trans.rurdu: Us mein malaayeka aur roohul quds izne Khuda ke saath tamaam umoor ko le kar naazil hote hai.
trans.urdu: اس میں ملائکہ اور روح القدس اذنِ خدا کے ساتھ تمام امور کو لے کر نازل ہوتے ہیں۔

lines.rarabic: SALAAMUN HIYA HATTAA MAT LA’IL FAJR.

trans.en: Peace! it is till the break of the morning.
trans.rurdu: Yeh raat tulu'e fajr tak salaamti hi salaamti hai.
trans.urdu: یہ رات طلوع فجر تک سلامتی ہی سلامتی ہے۔

trans.en: Almighty God the most high speaks the truth.
trans.rurdu: Allah buzurg o bartar ne sachh farmaya hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ بزرگ و برتر نے سچ فرمایا ہے۔
